title: The raise that made you poorer
description:
A 3% raise in a 5% inflation year is a pay cut. Here's the money illusion, explained simply.

New video every day.

headline: You got a 3% raise.
You got poorer.
Both are true.
scenes.say: You got a three percent raise. Prices went up five percent. You just took a pay cut while celebrating.
Your brain counts the number on the payslip. Your wallet counts what that number buys. Economists call the gap the money illusion.

headline: Ask for inflation
plus your growth.
scenes.say: So never negotiate against zero. Inflation is the floor. Anything below it is a cut with a nicer name. Follow for more.
